chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which there are exhortations for the people.
Regarding abstemiousness, fear of Allah, and the importance of preparing for the Hereafter.

key_terms.الآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter, the eternal life after death
key_terms.الزُّهْد: Abstemiousness or asceticism, detachment from worldly desires
key_terms.خَوْفِ اللَّهِ: Fear of God, a spiritual state of reverence and awe
key_terms.مَوَاعِظ: Exhortations or sermons containing moral advice

ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon on preparing for the afterlife in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Compiled by Sharif al-Radi, this sermon exemplifies Imam Ali’s (AS) rhetorical mastery in linking asceticism (zuhd) not merely as material renunciation, but as a spiritual discipline to cultivate God-consciousness (khawf). The emphasis on preparing for the hereafter reflects the Shia theological view of the transient nature of worldly life (dunya) as a testing ground for eternal success. This passage serves as a practical guide for believers to balance worldly duties with spiritual readiness, a core tenet of Ali’s governance and personal conduct.
